facts.label: official
facts.text: The Reserve Bank of India issued press release 1483 for the 2026-2027 fiscal year publishing monthly external commercial borrowing figures for September 2026.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Indian companies, including non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), filed proposals with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to raise $7.05 billion through external commercial borrowings (ECBs) and foreign currency convertible bonds (FCCBs) in September 2026, lower than $8.13 billion in August, according to RBI data.
facts.text: Indian companies filed proposals to borrow 7.05 billion US dollars through external commercial borrowings and foreign currency convertible bonds in September 2026.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Vodafone Idea plans to raise $1.5 billion and NaBFID $1 billion as India Inc's proposed overseas borrowings decline to $7.05 billion in September from $8.13 billion in August.
facts.text: Corporate overseas borrowing proposals stood higher at 8.13 billion US dollars in August 2026 before declining in September.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Of the total, $6.71 billion worth of proposals were under the general permission route, while $336.94 million was under the special permission route, the data showed.
facts.text: Out of the total proposed borrowings in September 2026, 6.71 billion US dollars were submitted under the RBI general permission route.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Of the total, $6.71 billion worth of proposals were under the general permission route, while $336.94 million was under the special permission route, the data showed.
facts.text: Overseas borrowing proposals submitted under the special permission route amounted to 336.94 million US dollars in September 2026.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Among the prominent companies that filed their intent in September was Vodafone Idea, which plans to raise $1.5 billion from a financial institution in the International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) for 10 years for local sourcing of capital goods.
facts.text: Telecom provider Vodafone Idea filed to raise 1.5 billion US dollars from an International Financial Services Centre institution for capital goods sourcing.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Mangang Constructions accounted for the largest borrowing proposal of about $1 billion for general corporate purposes, followed by the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID), which proposed $1 billion for on-lending.
facts.text: The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development registered proposals to raise 1.0 billion US dollars from international capital markets.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: SIP contributions declined from ₹32,490 crore to ₹32,160 crore.
facts.text: Monthly retail investments via mutual fund systematic investment plans stood at 32,160 crore rupees in October 2026.

intro.prompt: 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920, about 8 seconds, photorealistic and cinematic, bright vivid colour. Setting: view of a tall mobile telecom tower on a rooftop in a crowded Indian city at dusk, two workers in safety harnesses fitting new equipment, orange evening sky. The background is real and in motion behind him (as fits the place: waves, mist, leaves, flags, lamps flickering, people walking, traffic, light shifting); never a still, flat or heavily blurred backdrop. Framing: medium shot from the waist up, his whole head and both shoulders inside the frame with clear space above his hair and on both sides, and he stays framed like this to the end; do not crop the top of his head. Lighting: warm key light on the face, a soft rim light on the hair, matched to the scene; flattering, no harsh shadows, no dull or flat grey look. SG [locked] standing relaxed and upright, shoulders open, wearing a tan blazer over a pale pink shirt. Speaks from the first frame, mouth matched to the words, steady eye contact with the lens. Face and delivery: a confident, charismatic documentary presenter. Calm, natural face with a pleasant, warm smile, relaxed eyebrows, eyes soft and focused on the viewer. On "udhaar kyun maang raha" the eyes narrow a little with intrigue and the head tilts slightly, as if sharing a secret. On "Poora sach abhi batata hoon!" a warm, confident smile and one small nod. Natural blinking, subtle head movement. No exaggerated expressions: no wide eyes, no raised eyebrows, no open-mouth surprise, no big grin, no frown; never sad, gloomy, worried or tired. Voice: warm, clear, measured, with quiet intensity; a short pause before "udhaar kyun maang raha". Hands: one slow, small gesture toward the scene behind him on the first line, then hands rest; no fast or large arm movements. Camera: eye level, a very slight slow push-in, slight handheld feel. Empty hands, no prop. @SGLearning watermark in the top right corner, white, bold, 80% opacity. No captions, no subtitles, no other on-screen text. No hologram, no floating screen, no graph, no chart, no laptop, tablet, monitor, TV or glowing blue panel anywhere in the frame. Export at 1080x1920.
